text: Ichihime
Um, nyaa... If something like a kidnapping really happens, where should we look for clues, nyaa?
Saber
It sounds kinda complicated, nyaa.
Sakura Matou
I'm sorry I took so long.
Oh, did you manage to contact them, nyaa?
I see. Will they help us search too?
Yes, I believe they will.
You sound so sure, nyaa?!
They'll definitely help us after they find out that senpai is in danger.
Yep, it really is quite complicated, nyaa!
Senpai?
Well, he's very nice and reliable... and he's got a really big heart.
But you must be great friends if you can travel all the way to One Han City together from so far away. Right, nyaa?
Well... I guess so...
Fu Ji
Fu Ji, this is Sakura and Saber, nyaa!
Right! We don't have time for that right now, nyaa!
Nyaa? What's wrong, nyaa?
...Kidnapped?
Sorry, I want to make sure I've got it right.
It's probably more accurate to say that I was held under house arrest. That's what it felt like.
And this victim has red hair and was wearing a uniform similar to mine…
That was one heck of an experience! Getting kidnapped? Totally something worth trying at least once!
Senpai...
So, Shirou should be safe then, right?
Wait, if you're that badass, why did you let them kidnap you, nyaa?
Let's go there now. If we catch the kidnappers, that'll be the end of it.
P-Please! Take us there...!
This is the building where I was imprisoned...
Maybe we'll be able to find some other clues here.
Saber?
...S-Someone? Who could it be, nyaa?
...Given the timing, maybe it's one of the kidnappers.
They are here.
Saber, we're not enemies right now. No need to be so tense, yeah?
Tohsaka senpai...?
Hand of Fate
No one wants to try that, nyaa!
One Han City - Some District
Inside the Target Building
Let's first consider where the victims might be hidden. It's likely to be in buildings that are difficult to search thoroughly.
This city seems pretty safe. If you know your way around, it shouldn't be hard to find places that fit the bill.
That's true, nyaa! Though I can't guarantee we'll find your friend, let's at least try, nyaa!
You're doing us a great favor already. It turns out we really do need to rely on the help of locals for something like this.
So is Sakura reaching out to people she knows who might come help, nyaa?
It just happens that the two people she is contacting came to One Han City from the same place as us at the same time. We didn't travel together.
Yes, but they didn't pick up my call, so I sent them a message explaining the situation.
Our relationship isn't really one of companionship, so we shouldn't rely on them too much.
Fair point. Senpai is one grade ahead of me, has red hair, and was wearing our school's uniform when he came here.
Hmm, there are also high school students with red hair in One Han City, nyaa. Any other quirks or traits I should know about, nyaa?
He even helped me, someone who was basically a stranger to him. He's just too kind.
You're correct about him being an incredibly kind person, but that often leads him to act way too recklessly.
R-Really tight...?!
N-Not really. He saved me, so I really want to repay him...
Oh? Ichihime, and two unfamiliar faces? Why are you all in such a hurry? Did something happen?
Ah!
Oh, this is Fu Ji, and she owns a mahjong dojo called Luck and Fortune.
Hi! Since fate brought us together, why not swing by my place? A round of mahjong will bring good luck and keep misfortune at bay. What do you say?
S-Sorry... we're in the middle of something urgent right now. We'll definitely come when we are free.
Well, I bet my situation is more urgent than yours. Do any of you have a phone on you?
Hmph... I don't know which fool decided to kidnap me, but they did! First things first, I need to call the police, and then I'll settle the score.
I could have escaped earlier, but I decided to play along because I was worried there would be other victims.
To be precise, just as I was starting to think of a plan, that person started making a fuss, which drew the kidnappers' attention. I figured it was the perfect chance and slipped out.
The person she mentioned is gotta be Shirou. He was probably taken to the same place as Fu Ji after he was kidnapped.
Oh, so that guy's name is Shirou. Well, it's thanks to him that I could escape without a hitch.
But you can stop stressing about him getting hurt. Other than being locked up for a few days, I came out just fine.
They didn't lay a finger on me. Honestly, they were so polite that it wouldn't have surprised me if they'd said something like, "Please enjoy your stay here for a while."
Yeah, and I got the feeling that they also wanted to avoid using violence if they could.
But instead of calling them kind, I think they were just trying to avoid piling on more crimes. I mean, can you really call a kidnapper "kind"?

Well, since I stumbled into something like this, I figured I might as well dig up some info about the kidnappers and report them to the police for a reward. But unfortunately, after watching them for so long, I didn't find anything useful.
We're racing against time now. If we rush over now, we might still find the kidnappers and Shirou there.
B-But what can we do when we get there? The kidnappers will just lock us up if they are still there. That would be the end of us, nyaa!
Don't worry, I won't let anything happen to us.
Seems the kidnappers moved immediately after realizing I had escaped. Tsk, they're really cunning.
It's a shame that the kidnappers managed to slip away, but finding where they held their victims this quickly is already a big step forward.
Sure.
With your knowledge of this city, we'll have a greater chance of finding Shirou if we can get more people to help us.
But didn't you just say that there were only three of you...?
By the way, what's this Shirou Emiya guy like, nyaa?
Honestly, if I stumbled across him right now, I wouldn't even know he's the one we're looking for, nyaa!
Oh, I see. You two must be really tight with this Shirou Emiya, nyaa!
Fu Ji? What are you doing here, nyaa?
Hello, nice to meet you. A mahjong dojo? This city is truly all about mahjong.
You said you were kidnapped a few days ago and held captive until just now.
I see... After that, you escaped just now and happened to come across us.
Yes, I've been wandering around this area in search of clues about the kidnappers. I must be pretty lucky to run into you.
Did you get the chance to escape when a new victim was brought to the same place as you?
...Miss Fu Ji, can you take us to the building where they had you locked up?
Huh? I guess I can, but will you two ladies be okay? It could be dangerous there.
Oh? Alright then. I don't really know your situation, but it looks like you can deal with them yourselves.
Let's go. I'll take you there now!
They've already gone and taken everything with them. It looks like they left quite hastily.
You're right. Sakura, let's split up––
Someone's coming this way. Don't make any sounds.
What are you guys doing in a place like this?
